title: A generation of Malagasy filmmakers emerges
description: The 1970s and 1980s brought a succession of works by Malagasy filmmakers, including Sari, Lalao Fahiny and Tranon-kala in 1971; Benoît Ramampy's L'Accident in 1972 and Dahalo, Dahalo in 1984; and Raymond Rajaonarivelo's Tabataba in 1988. L'Accident received a short-film prize at FESPACO, while Tabataba brought Malagasy cinema to Cannes. The period also included institutional change and a severe decline in cinema attendance.

sources.note: Film titles and dates recovered from Filmada's earlier cinema chronology; each milestone needs direct festival, catalogue or archival citations.
